notes.title: New heroes added + Hero AI tweaking!
notes.content:
Demo updated to version 0.8.34:
[list]
[*] New heroes: Rogue and Drakeguard!
[*] Fixed heroes not noticing enemies!
[*] Fixed a bug where buildings aren't destroyed when they should be.
[/list]

Demo updated to version 0.8.33:
[list]
[*] Replaced the hero portraits.
[*] Fixed a bunch of bugs, including a major game crashing bug with the lightning strike item.
[/list]

Patch notes for version 0.8.32:
[list]
[*] Graphical fixes.
[*] Random bugfixes and tweaks.
[/list]

Patch notes for version 0.8.31:
[list]
[*] Fixed a game breaking UI bug with the pause screen.
[*] Tooltip issue in unit info fixed.
[*] Moved the market window to make it show all items (made it hidable too).
[*] Quality settings don't work in languages other than English - bugfix.
[*] Selecting a building from build list when hovering over another building in the map caused issues - fixed.
[*] German translation issue when adding a reward fixed.
[/list]

Patch notes for version 0.8.30:
[list]
[*] Bugfix: Restart function doesn't work when active pause enabled.
[/list]

Patch notes for version 0.8.29:
[list]
[*] Fixed the weird navigation issues in scenario 2 (strong hold).
[/list]

Patch notes for version 0.8.28:
[list]
[*] A ton of new items for heroes to find/buy.
[*] Made the enemies in Stronghold not spawn inside the city.
[*] Fixed an issue where heroes can't decide between exploring and going back to the market.
[*] UI changes/fixes.
[*] Translation fixes.
[/list]

Patch notes for version 0.8.27:
[list]
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts for menu bar (1, 2, 3, 4, etc.).
[*] Added a Town Hall shortcut (C).
[*] Fireball collision issues fixed.
[*] Zombie picked up fireball - bugfix.
[*] Added different hero names for different translations.
[*] Decreased archer draw sound volume.
[*] Music stops playing after some time - bugfix.
[*] Added Hero death sounds.
[/list]

Patch notes for version 0.8.26:
[list]
[*] Building on top of ruins issue - bugfix.
[*] Added Mouse edge scrolling.
[*] Building is being attack translation bugfix.
[*] Zoom in limited to make it more usable.
[*] Made the HP bar for buildings bigger.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo released!
notes.content:
Releasing the demo is a big step.
Some people already played it, I even had a booth at a board game festival, which was super cool, because I could see people playing the game live.
Hopefully you'll enjoy it!
If you'd like to give me your feedback and help the game become better please use the discord server, the ingame feedback form or the steam forums.

notes.title: Playtest the current alpha build!
notes.content:
Just created an official playtest for the game!
Would love to hear feedback from you!
Please check it out and let me know what you'd like to changed.
Use the ingame feedback form, steam discussions or discord to share your thoughts!

notes.title: The story begins..
notes.content:
Making this game is a lot of fun.
I hope playing it will also be a lot of fun for you!
I'd love to hear your thoughts on how I can make this game better!
I will be releasing a demo soon, can't wait to make it available!
